text:
Essen’s median asking rent stands at 9.7 €/m² in June 2026, up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 26.1 % over the past five years, placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive markets. The spread between the 25th and 75th percentiles (8.5 €/m²–11.15 €/m²) shows modest variation, while the asking premium over existing rents is 44 % (existing rent 6.72 €/m²).  

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.6 % and an average of 32 days on market; 21 % of listings are let within a week. Affordability is tight but not extreme, as a 60 m² unit costs 582 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 13.5 %.  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.24 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 9.97 €/m² and 10.38 €/m², implying a 5.5 % increase.
